tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Searches open remote and hybrid jobs listed on Remotejobb.se, a Swedish job board. All filters are optional and combine with AND; a filter given several values matches jobs with any of them. Returns compact job summaries with paging, the applied order, and facets: the number of matching jobs per fil

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Gets up to 5 jobs from Remotejobb.se by id: the full description (when the source allows it), salary, employment details, apply link and application deadline (apply_by). apply_method is "email" when applications are sent by email; apply_url then links to the job page on Remotejobb.se instead of open

tools.name: list_search_filters
tools.description: Lists the values accepted by search_jobs filters on Remotejobb.se: job categories and cities with their number of open jobs, plus work modes, remote scopes and employment types.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Lists companies on Remotejobb.se with their number of open jobs, website and company page, with paging. Without a name, companies with the most open jobs come first. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job · Public sink: get_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job · Public sink: get_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
